answer: OPAL-DEPTH: a maturity opal is stored as a generative recipe — seed crystal plus one deposition step per on-ledger attestation, never a stored score. At any close the engine re-derives the opal from its steps; a twin's recipe points upstream into one identity's attestation river, so one shared source betrays the whole farm. The ferrous pass then sorts the queue: rows with their own distinct non-kin attester streams float; shared-upstream clusters sink and their escrowed depth bonds burn. Per-clone cost: K epochs of real non-kin attestations.
